title: Post SPCX Earnings | Iran, Tesla, Rates, AI Chips
speaker: Meet Kevin (Kevin Paffrath)

macro_themes.view: An Iran deal is not priced in; a deal would trigger a V-shaped recovery and a giant euphoric rally.
Rising 2026 rental rates on A100, H100 and GB200 chips show AI productivity accelerating, refuting the depreciation-cliff bear case.
Agentic AI will hit jobs; rising Black unemployment and layoffs are an early canary, with the labor market likely rolling over in roughly a year.
Expects only one more Fed hike this cycle; soft labor data makes a December hike unlikely.
Very bullish on stocks for the next year, then risk of a downturn once the labor market rolls over.

calls.condition: Bullish rally contingent on an Iran deal; after ~1 year, bearish risk if labor market rolls over
calls.reason: SPY stuck below 725 after two rejections; expects a euphoric rally after an Iran deal and strong gains over the next year driven by AI.
calls.quote: I actually think we're going to see a giant euphoric rally in the stock market post an Iran deal.
